technology_name: Coconut and Palm Sap Syrup Production Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for a uniform quality, melt-free alternative to conventional palm ghur/jaggery.
description: A process to produce a sweetener syrup by concentrating the sap of coconut or palmyra palm. The syrup retains uniform quality and can be used directly without the melting and filtration steps required for conventional palm ghur.
applications: • Production of natural liquid sweeteners for direct consumption • Manufacturing of commercial confectionery ingredients • Processing of traditional instant coffee formulations • Formulation of alternatives to conventional palm ghur and jaggery
